Container.Name: CloakBrowser
Container.Overview: Stealth Chromium browser with 58 source-level C++ fingerprint patches. Runs as a CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) server with Xvfb headed mode for maximum stealth. Passes Cloudflare Turnstile, reCAPTCHA v3 (0.9 score), FingerprintJS, BrowserScan and 30+ detection sites. Per-connection fingerprint seeds allow multiple browser identities from a single container. Connect via Playwright API (Python/Node.js). Note: do not use Puppeteer to connect as it leaks detectable automation signals. WARNING: CDP gives full browser control - never expose port 9222 to the internet without authentication. ~190MB RAM idle, ~30MB per additional tab. Binary is free to use but not redistributable.

Config.Name: CDP Port
Config.Description: Chrome DevTools Protocol port. Connect via ws://[IP]:9222. SECURITY: Do not expose to the internet without additional authentication.

Config.Name: Browser Cache
Config.Description: CloakBrowser binary and profile cache directory. First run downloads ~200MB Chromium binary.

Config.Name: Persistent Profile
Config.Description: Browser profile data (cookies, localStorage, etc). Mount for persistent sessions across restarts.

Config.Name: GPU Acceleration
Config.Description: GPU for hardware-accelerated rendering. 'intel' = passthrough /dev/dri (iGPU, default). 'nvidia' = use NVIDIA GPU (change Extra Parameters to: --shm-size=2g --gpus all --runtime=nvidia, and remove --device=/dev/dri:/dev/dri). 'none' = software rendering only (remove --device=/dev/dri:/dev/dri from Extra Parameters).

Config.Name: Auto Update
Config.Description: Enable automatic background update checks for the stealth Chromium binary.

Config.Name: Idle Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds before idle browser processes are reaped. Leave empty for no timeout.

Config.Name: Proxy Server
Config.Description: HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for browser connections (e.g. http://user:pass@proxy:8080 or socks5://proxy:1080).

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: Only for NVIDIA GPU mode. Set to 'all' or specific GPU ID (0, 1, etc). Leave empty if using Intel iGPU.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Only for NVIDIA GPU mode. Driver capabilities to expose.

Config.Name: Binary Path Override
Config.Description: Skip download - use a custom local Chromium binary path inside the container.

Config.Name: Download URL
Config.Description: Download server for the stealth Chromium binary. Must include https:// prefix.

Config.Name: Skip Checksum
Config.Description: Skip SHA-256 verification of downloaded binary. Not recommended.
